subject: Sprint 1 training index, live Q&A slots, and action log
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@axionhealth.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@axionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Sprint 1 training index, live Q&A slots, and action log

Hi Sanjay / Maya —

Following our handoff call yesterday, here’s a compact plan to run Sprint 1 enablement and the associated live Q&A office hours. Goal: get your integrations hitting deterministic latencies for inference and validate end-to-end data flows by the end of the sprint.

Proposed schedule (all times PT):
- Tue Oct 20, 10:00–11:30 — Live walkthrough: deployment patterns, routing policies, KV cache basics
- Wed Oct 21, 09:00–10:00 — Office hours: open Q&A, model & quantization recommendations

Attachments: Axion_Training_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + module owners), implementation-checklist.xlsx (pre-work and role owners).

Prep asks for Axion team before Tue:
1) Confirm list of participants (engineers + security lead).
2) Share one representative prompt set and typical token-length distribution for inference.
3) Confirm ability to join Zoom with screen-share.

I’ve tentatively reserved the slots and can push calendar invites once you confirm participants. If you prefer a different cadence, we can shift Wed office hours to Thu.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Axion_Training_Agenda_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Hi all —

Added calendar invites for the two sessions and shared a short prep packet in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxxAxion/Training-Sprint-1. Zoom links are embedded in the calendar events. Quick checklist before Tue:
- Team members have access to the shared Drive folder
- Representative prompt file (thanks Sanjay) is uploaded to the folder
- Environment access: a token/API key for a staging model endpoint or a small sample dataset for demo (Rahul)

Session owners: Karthik will lead the deployment and runtime walkthrough; I’ll cover onboarding/console ops and observability; Priyom will handle billing/usage queries at the end of the session.

Attachments included here: implementation-checklist.xlsx (edit and assign owners directly).

If anyone needs a different time, flag by EOD Monday. Otherwise see you Tue.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-training: recording, short action log, and recommended next steps

Hi team —

Thanks for a good session this morning. Recording and concise action log below; longer notes are on the Drive folder. Recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/rec-20261020-session (also attached as session-recording-20261020.mp4).

Key takeaways and actions (owners / due dates):
- Runtime config: enable continuous batching with max_batch_size=64 for the 1–2s sequence distribution (Rahul) — DUE: 2026-10-27
- KV cache warmup: pre-warm on hot prefix patterns we discussed (Karthik + Rahul) — DUE: 2026-10-25
- Observability: add token-level latency dashboards and route-level cost breakdown (Marissa) — DUE: 2026-10-29
- Security paperwork: Priya to confirm retention window and KMS integration checklist (Axion) — DUE: 2026-10-23

Open questions to resolve in follow-up office hours: model quantization impact on fidelity for the clinical prompt family; caching TTLs for low-reuse prompts. I’ve tentatively booked an extra 45-minute office hours slot Fri Oct 22 at 11:00 PT — will keep if useful.

Attachments: session-recording-20261020.mp4 (recording stub).

Cheers,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: session-recording-20261020.mp4 (mp4)]
